voice.name: Open Sector - Borg Swarm
voice.note: Shares the Borg Swarm voice designed for the Leech (voices/leech.json); quickest and thinnest for the spy fly.
voice.description: A fast, hissing swarm chorus of many small synthetic voices speaking the same words together, like a hive of insect-like machines piloting alien craft: thin and sharp, raspy and buzzing, with dry clicking and a faint wet chitter between words, emotionless and eager, quick clipped cadence, a slightly metallic hollow resonance under the voice.

move.prompt: Tiny alien insect drone flying past overhead: a thin high-pitched fly buzz with a soft electric hum, quick and light, passing left to right, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Tiny alien insect drone shot apart in the air: a small sharp electric pop with a brief crackle, the buzz cutting out and a light tick of debris, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
